optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Fraud Analytics Analyst, Card Fraud Detection

professionalSummary.text: Analyses flagged-transaction outcomes and proposes rule threshold changes with their expected alert volumes.
professionalSummary.witness: Fraud analytics analyst in a card issuer's fraud detection team for three years, analysing flagged-transaction outcomes each week and proposing rule threshold changes with their expected alert volumes; the changes were approved by the fraud strategy manager.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepares the monthly fraud performance pack for the fraud strategy manager.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the monthly fraud performance pack for the fraud strategy manager, covering fraud losses, alert volumes, false positive rates and the effect of the month's rule changes.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Monitors the fraud model's alert precision and raises drift to the model owners.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Monitored the fraud model's alert precision on the weekly monitoring dashboard and raised two drift cases to the model owners, both recorded in the model monitoring log.

skills.text: Coordinates rule changes with the fraud operations desk and records own responsibility boundaries.
skills.witness: Coordinated each rule change with the fraud operations desk through the change note, recording which checks were mine and which belonged to the desk supervisor.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience in fraud analytics, rule threshold changes, performance pack preparation, model monitoring, and coordination with the fraud operations desk. They do not establish the candidate's visa sponsorship status or relocation support for her husband.

decisionBoundary.statement: The candidate's qualifications are supported by the provided evidence, but further human review is required to make a final employment decision.
